title: Native target builds need an explicit configure prerequisite on fresh lanes
body: The queued command tools/vixen-native.sh build build vixen-ninja ShaderManagementTests failed before compilation because build/ninja did not exist; the documented recovery required rerunning tools/vixen-native.sh build all vixen-ninja ShaderManagementTests to configure first, then later target builds worked. Tier haiku: one obvious launcher prerequisite/early diagnostic should make fresh target builds configure or fail before admitting the build step.
